# HiPeople

> > HiPeople is an AI-powered talent assessment and reference checking platform that helps companies streamline candidate screening, automate hiring workflows, and make data-driven recruitment decisions.

HiPeople offers 400+ skills assessments, automated reference checking, and seamless ATS integration (including Slack, Zapier, and major recruitment platforms). The platform serves companies like Redcare, DAZN, and OLX with AI-powered screening solutions that reduce hiring time and costs by up to 80%.

## Key Topics

- AI-powered candidate screening
- Reference checking automation
- Talent assessment platform
- ATS integration (Slack, Zapier)
- Recruitment automation
- Candidate evaluation tools
- Skills testing library (400+ tests)
- Background checks and verification
- Hiring workflow optimization
- G2 and Capterra reviews
- Demo requests and onboarding
- Competitor comparisons (Checkr, HireRight, iMocha)
- Multi-language support (Portuguese, Spanish, German)
- Compliance and ethics assessments
